overview_description.description: EverX is a blockchain technology company focused on developing infrastructure, tools, and decentralized applications for Web3 ecosystems. The company is known for its work on the Everscale blockchain, including protocol development, smart contract tools, and validator solutions. Its products and services support developers, enterprises, and blockchain communities working on scalable decentralized applications, digital asset platforms, and distributed network technologies.
